dataset_name.title: Nextclade dataset
dataset_name.description: Dataset name as listed by 'nextclade dataset list', e.g. nextstrain/sars-cov-2/wuhan-hu-1/orfs, nextstrain/mpox/all-clades, nextstrain/flu/h3n2/ha/EPI1857216.

dataset_tag.title: Dataset version
dataset_tag.description: Version tag of the dataset, e.g. 2024-10-17--16-48-48Z. Latest when blank.

sequences.title: Sequences
sequences.description: FASTA of sequences. When blank, the one FASTA in the input dataset is used.

name.title: Dataset name
name.description: Stem of the Auspice JSON written to auspice/<name>.json. Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.
